header: What permissions do I need to access Microsoft Defender XDR?
content:
Microsoft Defender XDR?
７ Note
Role-based access control settings in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint influence
access to data. For more information, read about managing access to Microsoft
By default, Microsoft Defender XDR displays time information in the UTC time zone. You
can also change this setting to use your local time zone.
To change time zone, sign in to the Microsoft Defender portal then go to System >
Settings > Microsoft Defender portal and select your preferred time zone. Refresh your
browser to ensure that changes are applied immediately.
The time zone settings is applied to the dates and times displayed in incidents,
automated investigation and remediation, and advanced hunting.
